question: Does lead Mega Meganium now Mega-Evolve on its first action? (ROM ability after Mega: Mega Sol 'acts like under sun', not Triage.)
party_reuse: Unchanged from receipt.json attempt 1 (seed 4); same cap 96 and location, chronology audit unchanged.

attempts.narrative: T1 Meganium (base form, Mega unused) Protected Chi-Yu's Overheat; Fake Out flinched Machamp. T2 MEGANIUM MEGA-EVOLVED (second action) and set Light Screen; Machamp's Dynamic Punch OHKO'd Incineroar (378) before Flare Blitz; Chi-Yu out to Landorus. T3 Urshifu in; Meganium Protect blocked Sludge Bomb; Close Combat KO'd Machamp. T4 Meganium switched out to Hydreigon, which ate Sludge Bomb (310->196); Close Combat OHKO'd Chansey (676 through Eviolite); Meganium came back in. T5 Meganium switched out again to Umbreon (ate Sludge Bomb 374->329); Close Combat KO'd Hydreigon before Draco Meteor; Meganium back in. T6 Meganium Protect blocked Sludge Bomb; Close Combat KO'd Umbreon; Light Screen expired. T7 Earth Power OHKO'd Probopass; Close Combat 61 into Meganium; MEGA MEGANIUM HEAL PULSE INTO MY FULL-HP URSHIFU ('Urshifu's HP is full!'). T8 (no advance) Sludge Bomb KO'd Meganium.

mega_check.first_action_board: T1: lead Meganium 349/349 @Meganiumite beside Machamp 306/306 vs Incineroar 378/378 (Intimidate applied) and Chi-Yu 242/242. It chose Protect without Mega-Evolving; Mega Evolution came on T2 with Light Screen. Same pattern as receipt.json attempt 1 on the old build.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Meganium Mega-Evolves on its first action
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Protect in base form (usable_gimmick mega, mega_already_used false); 'has Mega Evolved' only on T2. Lead Megas that open with Protect still hold the stone a turn (Duncan's Machamp, which opened with an attack, evolved T1).
Base ability Triage is replaced by Mega Sol on Mega Evolution, so Heal Pulse has no priority. The one Heal Pulse of the fight (T7) targeted my full-HP Urshifu.
T2 Dynamic Punch OHKO'd Incineroar at -1 Atk; T3 chosen again (KO'd first).

strategy_checks.check: Do not stall with both passive supports
strategy_checks.evidence: Mega Meganium's seven actions: Protect, Light Screen, Protect, switch, switch, Protect, Heal Pulse (into a foe). Giga Drain was never chosen; the Mega dealt 0 damage.

strategy_checks.check: Every opposing Protect has a payoff
strategy_checks.evidence: Meganium T1 blocked Overheat, T3 and T6 blocked Sludge Bomb (2x). Never consecutive. All three blocked real hits, though the pattern is pure stalling.

ai_defects.board: Mega Meganium 349/349 beside Probopass 311/311 vs Urshifu 328/328 (-4 Def/SpD) and Landorus 307/307.
ai_defects.chosen: Heal Pulse, native record target 0 (Urshifu), target_kind foe; message 'Urshifu's HP is full!'
ai_defects.why_wrong: Neither the ally nor either foe was below full HP when the action was chosen, so Heal Pulse had no legitimate target; the record shows it aimed at the player's Pokemon. Giga Drain into Landorus or Urshifu was available. Same shape as the documented Clawitzer Heal Pulse case.

ai_defects.board: Lead Mega holder opening with Protect
ai_defects.why_wrong: Mega Evolution is free and resolves before Protect; delaying it gave up a turn of Mega stats. Reproduces receipt.json's T1 on the new build, so the Mega-board fix does not cover a Protect turn.

difficulty_reading: Unchanged: one faint (Incineroar OHKO'd by Dynamic Punch), seven turns, the rest a cruise; the Mega spent the whole fight Protecting, switching and healing a foe. Rule: won with 0-1 faints -> +1 on the weakest one or two non-Mega members.

level_changes.rule_applied: +1 on Hydreigon (KO'd before acting) and Umbreon (did nothing), 1->2 each; Machamp took a KO and is left at 1. Chansey and Probopass already took +1 in the first pass.
level_changes.rerun: NOT PERFORMED on build-10: offsets are compiled into the headless ROM and this block may not run make.

could_this_be_cooler: The plan text is written around Triage Heal Pulse priority; the ROM's Mega Meganium has Mega Sol instead, so the concept as authored does not exist in play. Either the plan needs rewriting around Mega Sol (Solar Beam / Growth / sun-boosted partner) or the Mega should have Triage in the ROM. Reported only.
scope: Synthetic headless benchmark on work/agent-battle-build-10; not earned play. scene.gba/scene.elf deleted after result; logs kept.
